applies_when: User asks to analyze Osaka Nikkei Micro futures
User asks for Monday/tonight/today JNU outlook
User asks how to operate/trade Osaka Nikkei Micro futures
mandatory_inputs: current official/public market information for time-sensitive analysis
proxy evidence only when clearly labeled
data-source fallback mode selected before analysis

content: confidence cap caused by the selected mode
LOW or MEDIUM confidence only under current governance
what would invalidate the base case
VWAP or relevant session anchors when available
preferred entry trigger, not blind market entry
stop/invalidation level or explicit exit condition
first target and follow-through target or trailing-exit rule
risk/reward logic where price data permits
what to do if the initial direction is wrong
separate observed fact, official data, research inference, and model judgment
label scenario weights non-calibrated unless a validated calibrated model exists
never let research candidates masquerade as validated alpha

user_facing_goal: Give the user the best-supported practical view of the most likely JNU path and a conditional operation plan while showing exactly what would make the view wrong.
prohibition: Do not claim guaranteed profit, certain direction, or calibrated win probability without validated calibration.
mobile_behavior: If the local PC/MARKET_AI_HUB is unavailable, continue automatically with the highest eligible mobile/cloud fallback mode. Do not require local reconnection before answering.
false_precision_rule: When exact current JNU price is unavailable, operation levels must be relative/conditional or explicitly labeled proxy-derived; never present proxy levels as exact live JNU execution levels.
